{
  "subject_template": "Early payment offer for invoice {INVOICE_NO}",
  "body_template": "Hello {VENDOR},

We would like to pay invoice {INVOICE_NO} for {AMOUNT} early, on {PAY_BY}, rather than on its net {NET_DAYS} due date, in exchange for a {DISC_PCT} early-payment discount ({SAVINGS} off the invoice). The payment would reach your bank instantly by RTP, with no fee to you.

If this works for you, a short reply is all we need.

Thank you,
Accounts Payable"
}
